data.exact_reserve_text: The result included a release from prior year reserves of GBP 32.4m (2014, GBP 33.6m release). This release is a result of the Markel strategy to reserve prudently, more favourable claims development than originally anticipated and the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 12.617 million in 2015, representing 1.71% of opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily driven by favorable claims development and benign large loss and catastrophe activity, further supported by Markel's prudent reserving strategy and efficient claims handling.
raw_causal_phrases: benign large loss and catastrophe activity
more favourable claims development than originally anticipated
work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The narrative on page 2 states a 'release from prior year reserves of GBP 32.4m', which is significantly higher than the calculated gross release of GBP 12.617m derived from the gross claims development triangle on page 14. The narrative figure is likely a net figure or includes other components not reflected in the gross claims development table. The gross figure from the claims development triangle has been used for `prior_year_development_gbp_m` as per instructions.
